title: Thermochemistry Study Game
author: Dr. Dan (ItsDrDan)
description: Interactive thermochemistry study game for CHEM 3A and CHEM 1A. CHEM 3A includes phase and energy identification, q = mcΔT, phase-change heat, an interactive Heat Explorer, and multi-stage total heat. CHEM 1A adds heat and work (ΔU = q + w), pressure-volume work, calorimeter calibration, coffee-cup and bomb calorimetry, heat exchange, guided Hess’s law with equation reversal/scaling/cancellation, formation-enthalpy tables and missing-value calculations, and balance-then-calculate enthalpy stoichiometry. Challenge questions combine limiting reactants, remaining excess reactant, formation data, combustion heat, water heating, and phase changes. Features randomized practice, occasional challenges in Mixed Practice, units entered in homework format, varied answer precision, guided steps, hints, reveals, solution maps, completed work, scoring, streaks, celebrations, embedded ItsDrDan lessons, and an Intro-only PhET simulation. Responsive for desktop, mobile, and Canvas. Includes formation-data lookup exercises with an embedded OpenStax table, fraction coefficients, XP levels, achievement badges, and per-problem progress bars. Hess’s Law uses clickable reaction cards with live reversal, multiplier controls, synchronized enthalpy values, and visual cancellation before the final sum. The Hess bank contains 34 templates, including 24 additions adapted from uploaded practice worksheets, with manual paired-species cancellation and controls directly beneath the cards. Features the Beaker Buddy mascot embedded in the standalone game file. Complete-combustion prediction precedes balancing and calculations in combustion challenges and 15% of regular CHEM 1A formation and enthalpy questions.
